description: This is a PHP source file implementing a class 'kaiten' that provides an API interface to Kaiten.io for managing issues, comments, and related operations. It covers functions such as initializing a curl connection, adding issues, notes, external links, tags, and retrieving users and boards.

classes.name: kaiten
classes.description: A PHP class that facilitates communication with the Kaiten API for issue management, comments, tags, and user/board retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the kaiten object with context and optional configuration, setting up properties and curl connection.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes and configures curl with options including proxy setup and timeout.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL string for a specific issue by ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves an issue by ID from Kaiten API.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Kaiten with a given title, description, and optional parameters.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment note to a specific issue.

methods.name: addExternalLinks
methods.description: Adds external links to a specific Kaiten card.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a specific Kaiten card.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users from Kaiten.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Retrieves information about a Kaiten board.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method to perform GET requests to the API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Internal method to perform JSON API requests with specified HTTP method.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using curl, handling headers, body, and responses.
